Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：古代的时候，A multi-syllable time noun needs 的 before 时候; only fixed expressions such as 古时候 omit it. [teacher rule: de_shihou]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a concrete group of people, so use 人们 rather than the generic noun 人. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to the people whom Shennong informs, so use 人们 rather than the generic noun 人. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，Two coordinated indirect questions need clear parallel clauses, and 安全的／危险的 describe the kind of plant after 是. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们能吃什么植物：能吃什么植物，Use zero form when the embedded clause has the same referent as the main-clause subject; repeating the pronoun is unnecessary here. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，On first mention, briefly introduce a character with a full noun phrase rather than only assuming the reader knows who the name refers to. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉人们：告诉了人们，This is the final completed action in the sequence, so it takes 了; earlier actions in a series can remain without it. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 is multisyllabic, so 的 is required before 时候 under the teacher's rule.
This refers to a concrete group of people, so 人们 is required.
The people whom Shennong informs are a concrete group, so 人们 is appropriate rather than generic 人.
Both coordinated clauses need 的 after 安全 and 危险 in this construction.
他们 can appropriately refer back to the immediately preceding 人们; zero reference is possible but not required here.
神农 is a first-mentioned character and should be briefly introduced with a fuller noun phrase.
As the final action in the action sequence, 告诉 takes 了 under the teacher's aspect rule.
